edge_explainer: The market did not misprice Freshpet - it repriced it. At the January-2025 high of $164.07 the stock carried ~50x EV/EBITDA; today at $59.62 it carries 14.2x on the FY26 guide midpoint. Everything the drawdown is supposed to signal (a broken business) is absent: Q1'26 volume grew 14.6%, household penetration is only 15.2M of ~98M pet-food households, the balance sheet is roughly net-debt-neutral, and the current-year guide was RAISED in May. What is also absent is a discount. After a capex program that has taken net PP&E to ~1.0x sales (roughly double a normal food manufacturer), FY26 Adjusted EBITDA margin is guided BELOW FY25 (17.4% mid vs 17.8%), free cash flow is ~$30M against a $2.93B market cap, and normalized pre-tax return on invested capital is ~5.8% - under any defensible cost of capital. The most informative disclosure in the file is management's own: FY25 share-based compensation fell to $13.9M from $51.8M, with a NEGATIVE $6.4M in Q4, because performance awards tied to Adjusted EBITDA margin, Adjusted EBITDA and net sales were judged 'improbable of achievement.' The entire $37.7M improvement in GAAP operating income is that reversal. Freshpet discloses all of this plainly - so this is not an honesty catch, it is a valuation one. Separately, a -10.55% single-day break on 2026-03-17 on 5.5x normal volume has NO 8-K and no findable cause, and under the contract's cause-check gate an unread cause is an unknown, not a candidate.
honesty_grade: CLEAN with a mild review_flag. Adjusted EBITDA adds SBC back so the adjusted series is not flattered by the reversal; the reversal mechanism is footnoted verbatim; the FY25 net-income jump is explicitly attributed to the $68.4M valuation-allowance release; the Q1'26 $62.0M gain on equity investment is named in the highlights. The only divergence is emphasis: the Q1'26 headline reads 'Raises Net Sales Guidance' and the highlight bullets show Adjusted GROSS margin improving, while the facts that Adjusted EBITDA margin fell 80bps and the EBITDA guide was held appear only in the recon table and the outlook paragraph. Disclosed-but-de-emphasized = review_flag, not ELEVATE.
